relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Buying apps, services and products from each other.

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day fulfillment, service and integration work.

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Payments for orders, apps and services.

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Order updates, marketing and data shared under consent or scopes.

relations.name: Pays for orders
relations.description: Shoppers pay founders for orders, often through the saved-buyer wallet.

relations.name: Pays for orders across markets and channels
relations.description: Shoppers buy from scaling brands on storefronts, in AI assistants and abroad.

relations.name: Sends order, shipping and marketing updates
relations.description: Founders notify shoppers about shipments and, with consent, send campaigns.

relations.name: Serves shoppers in stores
relations.description: Retailers sell, hand over pickups and accept returns in stores.

relations.name: Installs paid apps
relations.description: Founders subscribe to partner apps billed through the platform.

relations.name: Hires agencies for replatforming and custom work
relations.description: Brands contract agency partners for migrations, checkout extensions and headless builds.

relations.name: Works with integrators on ERP and store rollout
relations.description: Retailers rely on integration partners for ERP connectors and POS rollout.

relations.name: Accesses store data under granted scopes
relations.description: Apps read and write merchant data only within the scopes the merchant approved.
